UML:ClassifierRole.name: OR041 Low supply alarm and pump switching

UML:TaggedValue.value: 01_Requirements

[Source requirement] If the seawater cooling system adopts a configuration related to the main circulation pump, low water supply conditions must be able to trigger an alarm to facilitate timely startup or switching.

UML:ClassifierRole.name: OR041.1 Low pressure alarm for seawater cooling

UML:TaggedValue.value: 01_Requirements

Under the configuration related to the main circulation pump, when the water supply pressure of the seawater cooling system falls below the set value, an alarm shall be triggered. Criterion: 0.15 MPa Grade: B Verification: Test Cited: E-DRAFT-COOLIN-AU TOSTA-001

$XREFPROP=$XID={4A1E3768-A1F1-46D7-8637-5B4CD361AF46}$XID;$NAM=Stereotypes$NAM;$TYP=element property$TYP;$VIS=Public$VIS;$PAR=0$PAR;$DES=@STEREO;Name=requirement;FQName=SysML1.4::requirement;@ENDSTEREO;$DES;$CLT={4A1E3768-A1F1-46D7-8637-5B4CD361AF46}$CLT;$SUP=<none>$SUP;$ENDXREF;

UML:ClassifierRole.name: OR041.2 Standby pump activation for low supply

UML:TaggedValue.value: 01_Requirements

The seawater cooling system shall be able to start or switch to a standby pump in a timely manner to cope with low water supply conditions. Criterion: {{TBD|unit:s|ref:KB_DRAFT_v1|component:standby pump|intent:startup time|hint:refer to evidence E-DRAFT-COOLIN-AUTOSTA-001, 3-5 seconds}} Grade: C Verification: Test Cited: E-DRAFT-COOLIN-AU TOSTA-001

UML:ClassifierRole.name: OR052 Maintenance space without pipe removal

UML:TaggedValue.value: 01_Requirements

[Source requirement] Maintenance access to the seal, bearing, and motor of the cooling water pump must have sufficient space; it should not be necessary to remove many pipes just to disassemble a small part.

$XREFPROP=$XID={FC0CFA2F-03C2-4FA4-BD9C-13B545D972AE}$XID;$NAM=Stereotypes$NAM;$TYP=element property$TYP;$VIS=Public$VIS;$PAR=0$PAR;$DES=@STEREO;Name=requirement;FQName=SysML1.4::requirement;@ENDSTEREO;$DES;$CLT={FC0CFA2F-03C2-4FA4-BD9C-13B545D972AE}$CLT;$SUP=<none>$SUP;$ENDXREF;

UML:ClassifierRole.name: OR052.1 Adequate maintenance space for pump part

UML:TaggedValue.value: 01_Requirements

Maintenance of the seal, bearing, and motor of the cooling water pump shall have sufficient space, allowing maintenance without removing a large number of pipes. Criterion: Axial clearance ≥ 1.5 × pump casing length, radial clearance ≥ shaft diameter + 100 mm Grade: A Verification: Inspection Cited: E-SUPP-MAINT-001

$XREFPROP=$XID={F4904F35-692F-4EBC-8E0C-111EB2ED3917}$XID;$NAM=Stereotypes$NAM;$TYP=element property$TYP;$VIS=Public$VIS;$PAR=0$PAR;$DES=@STEREO;Name=requirement;FQName=SysML1.4::requirement;@ENDSTEREO;$DES;$CLT={F4904F35-692F-4EBC-8E0C-111EB2ED3917}$CLT;$SUP=<none>$SUP;$ENDXREF;

UML:ClassifierRole.name: OR052.2 Adequate maintenance space for pump part

UML:TaggedValue.value: 01_Requirements

Maintenance of the seal, bearing, and motor of the cooling water pump shall have sufficient space, allowing maintenance without removing a large number of pipes. Criterion: Operating side clearance ≥ 600 mm Grade: A Verification: Inspection Cited: E-SUPP-MAINT-001

$XREFPROP=$XID={2FC0372C-A3E7-4311-90FF-0E012BE24DE9}$XID;$NAM=Stereotypes$NAM;$TYP=element property$TYP;$VIS=Public$VIS;$PAR=0$PAR;$DES=@STEREO;Name=requirement;FQName=SysML1.4::requirement;@ENDSTEREO;$DES;$CLT={2FC0372C-A3E7-4311-90FF-0E012BE24DE9}$CLT;$SUP=<none>$SUP;$ENDXREF;

UML:ClassifierRole.name: OR052.3 Adequate maintenance space for pump part

UML:TaggedValue.value: 01_Requirements

Maintenance of the seal, bearing, and motor of the cooling water pump shall have sufficient space, allowing maintenance without removing a large number of pipes. Criterion: {{TBD|unit:mm|ref:E-SUPP- MAINT-001|component:cooling water pump|intent:maintenance space|hint:the specific clearance value shall be determined based on pump dimensions}} Grade: C Verification: Inspection Cited: E-PUMP-MAINT-001

UML:ClassifierRole.name: OR008 Temperature control valve setting and lo

UML:TaggedValue.value: 01_Requirements

[Source requirement] The setpoint and installation position of the temperature control valve must be verified against the main engine requirements; otherwise, the water temperature may not be controlled within the appropriate range.

$XREFPROP=$XID={42554CF4-DC94-424F-B4EF-A942A0BE6EEF}$XID;$NAM=Stereotypes$NAM;$TYP=element property$TYP;$VIS=Public$VIS;$PAR=0$PAR;$DES=@STEREO;Name=requirement;FQName=SysML1.4::requirement;@ENDSTEREO;$DES;$CLT={42554CF4-DC94-424F-B4EF-A942A0BE6EEF}$CLT;$SUP=<none>$SUP;$ENDXREF;

UML:ClassifierRole.name: OR008.1 Valve setting verification for temperatu

UML:TaggedValue.value: 01_Requirements

The setpoint of the temperature control valve shall be verified against the main engine requirements to ensure the water temperature is controlled within the appropriate range. Criterion: Engine outlet water temperature controlled between 90 and 100 °C Grade: B Verification: Test Cited: E-SYS-COMP-006

$XREFPROP=$XID={73784FCD-75F7-422B-95F0-06D5B731B89A}$XID;$NAM=Stereotypes$NAM;$TYP=element property$TYP;$VIS=Public$VIS;$PAR=0$PAR;$DES=@STEREO;Name=requirement;FQName=SysML1.4::requirement;@ENDSTEREO;$DES;$CLT={73784FCD-75F7-422B-95F0-06D5B731B89A}$CLT;$SUP=<none>$SUP;$ENDXREF;

UML:ClassifierRole.name: OR008.2 Valve location for responsive temperatur

UML:TaggedValue.value: 01_Requirements

The installation position of the temperature control valve shall meet the distance requirement between the sensor and the valve to ensure timely water temperature control response. Criterion: Distance between the temperature sensor and the three-way mixing valve shall be 10 to 15 times the pipe diameter Grade: C Verification: Inspection Cited: E-TCV-TEMP-100

$XREFPROP=$XID={0FFA6CA3-0103-4CEE-BABF-8EC9291434ED}$XID;$NAM=Stereotypes$NAM;$TYP=element property$TYP;$VIS=Public$VIS;$PAR=0$PAR;$DES=@STEREO;Name=requirement;FQName=SysML1.4::requirement;@ENDSTEREO;$DES;$CLT={0FFA6CA3-0103-4CEE-BABF-8EC9291434ED}$CLT;$SUP=<none>$SUP;$ENDXREF;

UML:ClassifierRole.name: OR008.3 Temperature control valve pressure drop

UML:TaggedValue.value: 01_Requirements

The pressure drop across the temperature control valve shall meet the design requirements to ensure normal system operation. Criterion: Pressure drop across the three-way valve is 0.3 to 0.6 bar Grade: B Verification: Test Cited: E-TCV-TEMP-099
